recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It fixes the missed parent Account.coverage location in current build scope; no broader Account or Coverage semantic change is indicated.
issue_request: FHIR-11367 was Published/Persuasive for the PA work group and requested changing Account coverage wording from parties responsible for covering payment of the account to parties, such as insurances, that may contribute to payment.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged implementation commit aea6363 updated Account.coverage.coverage to the accepted contribution wording, but left the parent Account.coverage backbone short text using the rejected responsible-for-covering language. The 2021 source migration in 33b409a carried that partial application into source/account/structuredefinition-Account.xml.
additional_context: Account is active in source/fhir.ini and the current resource separately models Account.guarantor as the parties ultimately responsible for balancing the account. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that would narrow or reverse the Jira decision, and the combined branch had no prior FHIR-11367 reconcile commit before publishing.
reconciliation: Changed source/account/structuredefinition-Account.xml so Account.coverage.short and Account.coverage.definition use the accepted may-contribute concept while preserving the parent element's order/priority meaning. Updated source/account/account.svg only to keep the checked-in diagram title consistent with the authoritative StructureDefinition source.
source_changes: source/account/structuredefinition-Account.xml: Updated Account.coverage short and definition from responsible-for-covering payment language to may-contribute payment language while retaining ordering semantics.
source/account/account.svg: Updated the checked-in diagram title for Account.coverage to match the corrected StructureDefinition text.
